entities.summary: Mulai Ahmed er Raisuni, known as Raisuli to most English speakers, also Raissoulli, Rais Uli, and Raysuni; 1871 – April 1925) was a Sharif, and a leader of the Jebala tribal confederacy in Morocco at the turn of the 20th century.
